# Hanoi international school tuition reaches $38,000 a year
Tuition at international schools in Hanoi now reaches more than VND1 billion (about US$38,000) a year for some upper secondary students, while most schools charge around VND300-600 million before meals, bus services and other fees.
...
By mid-May, most had announced tuition for the 10-month 2026-2027 academic year.
Fees range from about VND100 million to more than VND1 billion a year, usually rising from kindergarten to secondary level.

# Living in Hanoi with kids: schools, areas and costs
- UNIS Hanoi's 2026-27 tuition runs from USD 17,460 (Early Years 3) to USD 39,870 (Grades 11 and 12), plus a one-off USD 1,750 enrolment fee, according to the school's fee schedule.
- BIS Hanoi charges VND 657.6 million for Year 1 in 2026-27, and the school says that fee includes uniforms, daily lunches, day trips and after-school activities.
...
## Which international schools are near each area?
### United Nations International School of Hanoi
Its 2026-27 schedule lists annual tuition of USD 33,330 for Grades 1 to 5 and USD 35,210 for Grades 6 to 8.
...
### Concordia International School Hanoi
Tuition for Grades 1 to 5 rose from VND 797.95 million in 2025-26 to VND 861.79 million in 2026-27, roughly 8%.
...
## When does the school year run in Hanoi?
UNIS Hanoi and Dwight both opened 2026-27 on 12 August 2026; Dwight's calendar shows a Tet holiday from 4 to 12 February 2027 and a last day on 9 June 2027.

content.text:
## Hanoi international-school tuition comparison

The latest figures available here are for **2026–27**. Tuition is annual and generally excludes transport and some other extras. VND figures are rounded; USD fees were converted in the cited report, so exchange rates can affect comparisons.

| School | Kindergarten | Primary | Secondary |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **UNIS Hanoi** | VND **460–708m** | **878m** | **927m–1.05bn** |
| **Dwight School Hanoi** | **360–676m** | **825m** | **881m–1.002bn** |
| **Brighton College Vietnam** | **676–736m** | **736–756m** | **871–998m** |
| **British International School (BIS) Hanoi** | **511–524m** | **658–735m** | **847–970m** |
| **Hanoi International School (HIS)** | **440m** | **613–624m** | **675–797m** |
| **St. Paul American School Hanoi** | — | **666m** | **778–855m** |
| **International School ParkCity Hanoi (ISPH)** | **211m** | **328–590m** | **590–692m** |
| **Singapore International School** | **152–359m** | **255–501m** | **292–626m** |
| **British Vietnamese International School (BVIS)** | **259–351m** | **489–514m** | **615–709m** |
| **Horizon International Bilingual School** | **250–315m** | **300–552m** | **328–656m** |
| **Japanese International School (JIS)** | — | **100m** | **105–115m** |
| **True North International School** | **300m** | **200–530m** | **240–650m** |

*Amounts in VND millions per year. Ranges can reflect different year levels or bilingual and international programs; blank cells mean a figure was not provided in the comparison.*

### Quick takeaways

- **Highest-priced options:** UNIS and Dwight are among the costliest, with upper-secondary tuition reaching roughly **VND 1 billion or more**. Brighton and BIS also approach that level.
- **Mid-to-upper range:** HIS, St. Paul and BVIS generally sit below the top tier for secondary tuition, though costs vary by grade.
- **Lower published tuition:** JIS, ISPH, Horizon and some Singapore International School or True North programs show lower headline fees. Check the exact program and what it includes before comparing like-for-like.
- **Extra costs matter:** Registration, admission or enrolment fees and deposits can be substantial. Meals, bus service, uniforms, activities and facilities may be charged separately; the cited comparison estimates some extras at roughly **VND 10–40m each**.

For a more apples-to-apples comparison, check the exact grade, curriculum, included services and first-year charges. For example, UNIS lists annual tuition of **US$33,330 for Grades 1–5** and **US$39,870 for Grades 11–12**, plus a **US$1,500 tuition deposit**. BVIS says its tuition includes lunches, day trips and compulsory student health insurance, while uniforms and bus service are separate.

**Sources:** [2026–27 Hanoi school-fee comparison](https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/education/hanoi-international-school-tuition-reaches-38-000-a-year-5074942.html); [UNIS Hanoi fees](https://www.unishanoi.org/admissions/tuition-fees); [BVIS Hanoi fees](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bvis-hanoi/admissions/tuition-fees).
